Location : Philippines (GMT +8)

Remote : Yes (Global)

Willing to relocate : No

Technologies : Python, Docker/Podman, PostgreSQL, JS

Resume/CV : https://pdlozano.com/freelance-resume/

Resume/CV (PDF) : https://assets.pdlozano.com/Freelance%20Resume.pdf

Email : pauldavidlozano@gmail.com

I am a hardware engineer by day but I code a lot in my free time. My software philosophy is maintainability over development speed. I deeply appreciate well engineered software that focuses on UX and makes the right tradeoffs to do its job.

I have a self hosted server that has been running for more than a year now. Aside from the weekly maintenance I do, I barely touch it unless I want to.

What I bring:

- Python Backend Development: Clean, type-hinted code, RESTful API design, data pipelines/ETL, and database modeling with PostgreSQL. - Automation & Tooling: Experienced in turning repetitive, manual multi-step engineering workflows into robust, automated CLI tools and background jobs. - DevOps & Infrastructure: Self-hosted homelab operator comfortable with containerized deployments (Docker/Podman), Linux administration, and CI/CD automation.

Available for: Part-time contract work, backend feature development, workflow automation/scripting, and lightweight deployment/DevOps tasks.
